BRA.sampling_design: 127 grouped charts crossed with six slope classes; proportional stratification with minimum 500 points per chart.
BRA.important_group_dependence: Forest formations group collapses 3/6/49, but formations-plus-savanna includes classes affected by biome-specific harmonization. Published all-legend accuracy is not an endpoint area-error bound for either group.
BRA.unresolved_requirement: Obtain compatible collection-3 labels, inclusion weights/stratum population totals and boundary/sparse-class treatment; estimate reference-defined endpoint areas or set-error budgets. Pair covariance is useful but not mandatory if simultaneous endpoint bounds suffice.

IDN.sampling_design: Seven geographic regions crossed with six slope classes, 42 strata.
IDN.unresolved_requirement: Compatible current-map reference labels including 2023, design weights and population totals, or defensible independently calibrated endpoint error bounds. Earlier pooled classification accuracy cannot certify a 2015-2023 change sign.

volume_standard_error_source_tables: NFI12 supplementary S2 sheet 20a cells N61:O61
NFI13 supplementary S2 sheet Table 55 cells N60:O60
FIN.sampling_variance_methods: NFI12 spatial systematic sampling variance; NFI13 spatially balanced cluster design and approximate Voronoi-neighbour variance estimator. Reported standard errors quantify sampling uncertainty, not all measurement/model errors.
